sources.location: HTTP range read, first 300 kB of 20210506_FJ_MWN_15cm_140min_500ng_Shengda_WT_Cell_Exp_01.raw (ftp.pride.ebi.ac.uk/pride/data/archive/2022/08/PXD031490/)

claims.evidence: All 40 RAW files in the PRIDE list, each claimed once; the .pdResult search file is not a data file. Four 20210521 'reruns' files (WT_SN_Exp_02/04/05, Sol_SN_Stat_05) are the only file for their condition/replicate, so they are not treated as technical replicates.
PRIDE organism NEWT:1654360; title and description.
Description: in-frame deletion mutant of sol gene vs wild-type S2753; file names WT / Sol.
Sample protocol: samples collected at exponential and stationary growth points; file names Exp / Stat.
Protocol: culture centrifuged, supernatant filtered and protein-precipitated separately from washed cell pellet; file names Cell / SN. Labels are our wording; PRIDE organism part BTO cell culture.
Replicate index from file names (_01.._05); 5 per condition. Not confirmed in paper text.
PRIDE field and RAW header ('Q Exactive - Orbitrap MS', Thermo EASY-nLC).
LysC 1:50 then trypsin 1:100 overnight; only Trypsin recorded since column is single-valued.

claims.value: Carbamidomethyl C fixed; Oxidation M, Deamidated N/Q, Acetyl protein N-term variable
claims.evidence: dataProcessingProtocol (Proteome Discoverer 2.4). Deposited .pdResult (36.9 GB) not opened.
Label-free DDA presumed from Q Exactive/Proteome Discoverer LFQ; no explicit statement of DDA in protocol.
Q Exactive fragmentation is HCD; RAW header has Fragmentation_HCD method node. Inferred.

claims.location: comment[precursor mass tolerance] / comment[fragment mass tolerance]
claims.evidence: Not stated in protocol; would be in the unopened .pdResult.
LFQ enabled in Proteome Discoverer; no labelling.

limitations: Paper full text not retrieved (Europe PMC fullTextXML returned 500; PMC efetch gave metadata only); design is taken from the PRIDE protocol and file names.
DDA, HCD and replicate numbering are inferred, not stated verbatim.
Mass tolerances unavailable: the only search output is a 36.9 GB Proteome Discoverer .pdResult, not opened.
Lys-C step not representable (single-valued cleavage agent column); reconcile flags this as MAJOR cleavage_agent_incomplete, deliberately left as Trypsin.
Strain/growth phase/cell fraction are custom characteristics and are not in the ms-proteomics template; no organism-specific template exists for bacteria.
Culture medium, temperature and time points not stated in PRIDE record.
